purpose: B1 mutation ledger, final. Observed verdicts against predictions frozen before execution, classified under the frozen rule in full.
isolationDeviation: The frozen protocol said one dedicated clone per mutation. Execution used ONE clone with verified restoration between mutations instead: every pinned digest is re-checked before and after each mutation, and the run HALTS if restoration fails. This is declared rather than silently substituted. Restoration was verified for every row below.
driverClassificationCorrection: The execution driver classified any non-zero gate exit as DETECTED. The frozen protocol requires more: DETECTED holds only if the failure NAMES the mutated quantity, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. The driver under-implemented this audit's own rule. Every row was reclassified by inspecting the actual failure text; driverVerdict is retained beside the corrected verdict so the correction is auditable.
headlineFindings: NO SEMANTIC DISCRIMINATION ACROSS THE OBSERVED-EXPERIMENT PIPELINE. Five structurally different mutations - inverted CW/CCW semantics, inverted score sign, admitting censored dwells, removing the leakage guard, and falsifying the protocol freeze date - produce BYTE-IDENTICAL failure signatures: a report SHA-256 mismatch plus the CRLF hash failure. The suite detects that something in the pipeline changed; it cannot say what.

THE C3 CRLF DEFECT CONFOUNDS THE ENTIRE BATTERY. Every mutation whose regeneration runs scripts/run-observed-experiments.mjs triggers the WADHWA_2022_EVENTS hash failure regardless of what was mutated, because copyFileSync corrupts the served mirror. Until C3 is fixed, mutation testing of this pipeline cannot attribute a failure to the mutation.

DETECTION IS DRIVEN BY A SOURCE-HASH CHAIN, NOT BY SEMANTICS. run-observed-experiments.mjs embeds sha256(lib/observed-experiment.js) into the report, so ANY edit to that file is detected irrespective of meaning. This is why M07a was detected despite the prediction that it would survive.

CONFIRMED: the adverse lognormal result is defended by exactly ONE assertion. M10a-corrected shows the assertion fires when the result is genuinely removed. M10b shows that commenting it out leaves npm test, science:verify AND cross-study:verify all green. The protection works, and it is a single point of failure.

CONFIRMED: the derived-labelled-OBSERVED route is live and unguarded (M03b SURVIVED) while the structural route is guarded (M03a DETECTED_SEMANTIC). The matched pair isolates exactly which relabelling the suite resists.

CONFIRMED: M08 cannot run. scripts/ingest-cross-study-evidence.py requires EXTRACTED upstream directories that no repository document specifies. Recorded NOT RUN, never SURVIVED. This is a reproduction blocker independent of the mutation.
auditSelfCriticism: M10a was MIS-TARGETED. The frozen patch inverted mixtureVsWeibull, a paired-delta field, while the adverse-result assertion reads meanLogScoreNatsPerEvent. The mutation left the ordering unchanged and therefore tested nothing. It was caught only because the evidence was inspected rather than the exit code trusted. Superseded by M10a-corrected, which was verified to have the intended effect before its verdict was recorded.
The execution driver applied a weaker classification rule than the frozen protocol required. Corrected by manual reclassification of every row, with the driver verdict retained for audit.
Evidence capture truncated at six failure lines per gate, which was too narrow to classify M10a. Widened by targeted re-runs.

predictionAccuracy.note: Predictions used a coarse DETECTED label while the corrected classification splits DETECTED into SEMANTIC and HASH_ONLY. Where the frozen predictedDetectorKind matched the observed kind, the mechanism prediction was correct even where the coarse label differed. M07a is the one genuine mechanism failure: SURVIVED was predicted, DETECTED_BY_HASH_ONLY observed, because the audit did not account for the source file's own hash being embedded in the report.
